adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#6
adds.text: After Daisy saves her in Baltimore, Yo-Yo backs her story, and together they erase every record of Yo-Yo's trip from S.H.I.E.L.D.'s system. Yo-Yo tells Daisy she did not kill Ramon and gives her Peggy Carter's old pin as a reminder that she is part of the team.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: A fellow Inhuman who keeps Daisy's secret and gives her Peggy Carter's pin.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: A fellow Inhuman who saves Yo-Yo in Baltimore and helps erase her trip.
adds.evidence: Slingshot#5 (Deal Breaker): Quake frees the captive Yo-Yo and holds off the Watchdogs. Slingshot#6 (Justicia): Yo-Yo offers to help the fugitive Daisy, who declines; in the present the two delete all record of Yo-Yo in Baltimore from Mace's office, and Yo-Yo tells her she did not kill Ramon and gives her Peggy Carter's old badge, as Coulson did for her. Slingshot#1 (Vendetta) opens with them agreeing to get their story straight for Mace.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#3
adds.text: Jemma checks Yo-Yo's pulse while finishing her Inhuman registration, and Yo-Yo knocks over lab equipment and talks up apartment hunting to keep her from seeing the search on the lab computer.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: S.H.I.E.L.D. scientist who registers Yo-Yo, kept from seeing her search.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Inhuman Jemma registers, who distracts her to hide a search for Ramon.
adds.evidence: Slingshot#3 (Progress): Simmons and Fitz complete Yo-Yo's Inhuman registration; Simmons checks her pulse, Yo-Yo knocks over equipment to distract them and suggests they look for an apartment, and Simmons leaves.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#3
adds.text: Fitz upgrades Yo-Yo's watch so S.H.I.E.L.D. can monitor her powers and scolds her for getting Jemma hooked on apartment hunting, unaware she is using the lab computer to find Ramon.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Engineer who upgrades Yo-Yo's watch to monitor her powers.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Inhuman whose watch Fitz upgrades, who hides a search from him.
adds.evidence: Slingshot#3 (Progress): Fitz upgrades Yo-Yo's watch, chastises her for making Simmons obsessed with an apartment, and tells her the watch lets S.H.I.E.L.D. monitor her powers; after he leaves she finds Ramon is in Baltimore.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#4
adds.text: May works out that Yo-Yo stole Mace's lanyard, takes it back and scolds her for sloppy spy work, then keeps quiet and quietly sends her Quinjet to Baltimore.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who catches Yo-Yo's theft, keeps quiet and sends her to Baltimore.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Friend May catches stealing Mace's lanyard and quietly sends to Baltimore.
adds.evidence: Slingshot#3 (Progress): May hints she knows who stole Mace's lanyard. Slingshot#4 (Reunion): on the Quinjet May takes the lanyard back, warns her about sloppy spy work, promises not to tell S.H.I.E.L.D., and the pilot says he is taking her to Baltimore instead of Los Angeles; May grins and nods.

adds.title: Agents of S.H.I.E.L.D.: Slingshot#1
adds.text: On his way out after stepping down as Director, Coulson urges Yo-Yo to give Mace a chance and gives her a pin that belonged to Peggy Carter, so she remembers she is part of a team.
adds.on_a_card_about_b: Friend who gives Yo-Yo Peggy Carter's pin before leaving to find Daisy.
adds.on_b_card_about_a: Friend Coulson gives Peggy Carter's pin, to remind her she is part of a team.
adds.evidence: Slingshot#1 (Vendetta): Coulson enters with his belongings after stepping down, talks with Yo-Yo about the changes under Mace, advises her to give Mace a chance and gifts her a pin that belonged to Peggy Carter so she remembers she is part of a team; both hope he will find Daisy.
